title: Kirby Super Star Ultra - Vengeance, The Mask's Awakening ~ Masked Dedede (Remix)
description:
𝒪𝓊𝓇 𝑔𝓇𝓊𝒹𝑔𝑒 𝓌𝒾𝓁𝓁 𝒷𝑒 𝓈𝑒𝓉𝓉𝓁𝑒𝒹 𝒶𝓉 𝓁𝒶𝓈𝓉...
𝑀𝑒𝑒𝓉 𝓂𝓎 𝓅𝑜𝓌𝑒𝓇𝒻𝓊𝓁 𝓈𝑒𝒸𝓇𝑒𝓉 𝓌𝑒𝒶𝓅𝑜𝓃...
𝒯𝒽𝑒 𝒷𝓇𝒶𝓃𝒹-𝓃𝑒𝓌 𝒟𝑒𝒹𝑒𝒹𝑒 𝐻𝒶𝓂𝓂𝑒𝓇!

Did an arrangement of the one and only, Masked Dedede's Theme, from Kirby Super Star Ultra for my 5K subscriber milestone. A massive goal reached deserves some treatment from the King himself. I already did his theme once... now it's time to do it again!!!

It shouldn't be a surprise when I say this is my favorite Kirby theme and one of my favorite final boss themes in any video game period. Seriously, to top the original song (which is already one of the best songs in the series) with this is an achievement very few can achieve.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@1 replaces @9 to save on space).

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. C# Minor w/ slight detune (Remix Pitch - Listening Only)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. C# Minor (Remix Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. C Minor (Original Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ4. B Minor (GaMetal Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ5. D Minor (Candid Friend Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Voice Clips, but at the cost of SMW-Compatibility
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Voice Clips [turned on default]
